meta.title: Werkwoordpatronen in de diepte
meta.subtitle: Werkwoord + voorwerp + infinitief of -ing, en werkwoorden om iets na te vertellen (accuse of, urge to)
meta.next: Volgende: C2 · pdf 5 — Retoriek en stijl

blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: werkwoorden met een voorwerp en een infinitief of -ing-vorm gebruiken
precieze werkwoorden kiezen om iets na te vertellen (accuse, urge, deny)
de patronen van suggest, recommend, insist correct gebruiken
waarnemingswerkwoorden gebruiken (I saw him leave / leaving)

blocks.text: 1. Werkwoorden om iets na te vertellen

head: Patroon
Voorbeeld
Werkwoorden
rows: advise, encourage, warn, persuade, remind, urge
accuse of, blame for, apologise for, insist on
She explained that she was ill.
explain, claim, admit, point out, insist

blocks.title: Precieze werkwoorden in plaats van say
blocks.text: In plaats van steeds he said gebruik je op C2-niveau het werkwoord dat de bedoeling weergeeft: "I'll do it" → He promised to do it; "You stole it!" → She accused him of stealing it; "Don't touch it" → He warned me not to touch it.

head: Goed
Fout
rows: She suggested going to the cinema.
She suggested to go to the cinema.
I recommend you to book early. (vermijden)

blocks.title: suggest nooit met voorwerp + to
blocks.text: suggest heeft nooit het patroon suggest someone to do. Gebruik suggest doing of suggest that someone (should) do. Het Nederlandse Hij stelde voor om te gaan = He suggested going.

head: Engels
Betekenis
rows: I saw him cross the road.
I saw him crossing the road.
ik zag een deel ervan, hij was bezig
He was seen to leave. (lijdend: met to)
He denied to take the money.
He insisted to pay the bill.
He insisted on paying the bill.
The rain prevented us to go out.
The rain prevented us from going out.
She congratulated me for my exam.
She congratulated me on my exam.
He was seen leave the building.
He was seen to leave the building.

blocks.text: Vul het juiste woord of de juiste vorm in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.full: She persuaded me to take the job.
He insisted on carrying my bags.

items.q: The fog prevented the plane ______ landing.
items.full: The fog prevented the plane from landing.

items.q: She warned us not ______ swim there.
items.full: She warned us not to swim there.
We congratulated them on their wedding.

items.q: I heard someone ______ my name, but nobody was there.
items.full: I heard someone call my name, but nobody was there.

items.q: The suspect was seen ______ the bank.
items.full: The suspect was seen to enter the bank.

items.q: Hij stelde voor om te gaan wandelen.
items.a: He suggested going for a walk.

items.q: De regen verhinderde ons om buiten te spelen.
items.a: The rain prevented us from playing outside.

items.q: Zij haalde me over om te blijven.
